senses.gloss:
Tooth,Ⓒs.ⒹdaMtaH, daSanaH, radaH, radanaH, daMSaH, daMzwrA, dvijaH, jaMBaH; ‘two middle foreteeth’ rAjadaMtO; ‘double teeth’ mAQi f.
Ⓑ
 2 (Of a saw) daMtaH; ‘t(ooth)-picker’ daM-tasya nizkozaRaM, daMtolleKanI; SoDanI, nirGarzaRakaM; ‘t(ooth)-powder’ daMtaSoDana cUrRaM, daMta pavanaM; ‘t(ooth)-brush’ daMtapavanaM-kUrcakaM; ‘having good teeth’ sudat; ‘in the teeth of’ anAdftya (with acc.) or by abs. constr.; See ‘In spite of’ under Spite, ‘in the teeth of the Vedas’ vedezu jAgarUkezu satsu Apa.
Ⓝ[Tooth]ed,Ⓒa.ⒹdaMta, dat in comp.
Ⓝ[Tooth]less,Ⓒa.ⒹdaMtahIna, galitadaMta, nirdaMta-nIrada, Bagna-udDfta-daMzwra.
Ⓝ[Tooth]some,Ⓒa.ⒹsvAdu.
ⓃTeething,Ⓒs.ⒹdaMtodBedaH, daMtodgamaH.

Total,Ⓒa.Ⓓsakala, sarva, samagra, saMpUrRa, &c.; See Whole; ‘t(otal) rout’ atyaMtanASaH, supalAyitaM; ‘t(otal) disorder’ atyaMtamAkulaM.
Ⓝ[Total]ity,Ⓒs.ⒹsAkalyaM, samazwi f., EkyaM, kArtsnyaM; ‘what is the t(otality)’ evaM sarve (piMqIkftya) kati saMpadyaMte.
Ⓝ[Total]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹsaMpUrRaM, sAkalyena, sarvaTAtaH, aSezeRa, niHSezaM.

Totter,Ⓒv.Ⓓpra-, sKal 1 P, kaMp 1 A, vi-cal 1 P; See Shake.
Ⓝ[Totter]ing,Ⓒa.ⒹsKalita, sKalita-vihvala-gati.
